notes: `לָכֵן` fused to the single *Therefore* under rule 30 and headed on the governing first morpheme (rule 23); a split into *There-* / *-fore* is not independently recoverable.

The waw of `וְלֹא אָבִין` is `unrepresented` while *that which* joins the verb's own unit. That follows rule 46's reading, which marks an antecedent-plus-relative pair such as *that which* as the headless-relative case, whereas the bare *which* of the closing clause is given to its waw under rule 17. Both waws were read against what the ASV actually wrote rather than uniformly.
